name: base
purpose: default parameters, 5 ns clock. Power-up with tap codes 3/3 and an empty history: the first decision has no feedback and the second uses tap 1 only; a feedback that cancels; decisions that the feedback turns against the raw input. Tap codes change to 2/1 between edges, and the paper example of the decision card: vin = 0.46 V gives low after history (+1, -1) and high after (-1, +1). A reset that rises between edges and spans two edges while the tap codes change to 1/3; the first two decisions after it. vin changes in the middle of every clock interval.
